[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==

'''Mary Glasgow''' married a man named '''Thompson''' and had children, but no record of her own birth, marriage or death has been located and her husband's forename is unknown.

She is identified by the probate citation in the estate of [[Glasgow-4070|Nancy Glasgow]] of Plattsburgh, New York. The citation, dated 14 January 1892, lists "the children of Mary Thompson whose names and places of residence are unknown" among Nancy's heirs and next of kin, in the same group as the children of John, Alexander and Robert Glasgow, of Jane (Glasgow) Dysart, of Elizabeth (Glasgow) Anderson (sons "living at Gortahar") and of Ann McClelland.<ref>''The Plattsburgh Sentinel'', 26 February 1892, p. 6 (citation dated 14 January 1892). [https://www.nyshistoricnewspapers.org/?a=d&d=plts18920226-01.1.6 newspaper page]; also printed in ''The Plattsburgh Republican'', 23 January–13 February 1892.</ref>

The citation’s grouping supports Mary as a '''probable deceased sister''' of Nancy. It does not expressly state every sibling relationship or prove that the proposed siblings shared a father. Full versus half siblinghood and Mary’s parents remain unresolved (see Research Notes).

== Research Notes ==

This is the thinnest of the sibling profiles. Mary is not named in any located Irish record; her LNAB Glasgow, her parentage and even her Irish residence are inferences from the probate citation. Her parents are reassessed as [[Glasgow-4090|John Glasgow, farmer]] (uncertain) and an unknown mother. No dates should be added without a record. A civil death of a Mary Thompson, widow of William Thompson, farmer, at Tannybrake, Connor parish, on 7 March 1888 aged 73 is an age-compatible candidate but is NOT proved to be this Mary.

=== Scottish indexed candidate, September 2026 ===

A Scottish marriage index records Mary Thomson, aged 37, marrying William Sneddon on 9 November 1860, with parents Robert Thomson and Mary Glasgon Thomson. The older extracted index places the marriage at Old Monkland, Lanarkshire. The mother is a candidate for this citation-defined Mary Thompson only: no Irish origin or Nancy relationship is established, and the original image was not inspected.<ref>FamilySearch, ''Scotland, Civil Registration, 1855–1875, 1881, 1891'', [https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:6TLK-6T1J Mary Thomson bride index] and [https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:6TLK-6T1K mother index]; 9 November 1860. [https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:XT1H-TBC Older extracted marriage index], Old Monkland, Lanarkshire. Both concern the same event. Indexes inspected 29 September 2026; original 008056939_011_M9H1-8LK, image 32, restricted to a FamilySearch centre or affiliate library.</ref>

On the reported ages, the Tannybrake widow mentioned above would have been about eight at the Scottish daughter's birth around 1823. The candidates should therefore be kept separate unless an age or identity correction is established. No spouse or child from the Scottish index is assigned here.
